DeepSeek Harness is taking a different approach to AI coding agents.

Instead of locking the model, tools, memory, and interface into one closed system, it treats the entire coding environment as a collection of plugins. That means you can swap models and customize the tools and workflow around them.

DeepSeek also launched V4 Pro alongside it, giving developers another powerful option for coding and agentic workflows at a much lower cost.

If you're using Claude Code, Codex, or other AI coding agents, this is definitely worth exploring.

caption.text:
Have you ever wondered how a tablet knows where your pain is? 🤔
The truth is—it doesn’t. After you swallow a tablet, it dissolves in your stomach or intestines, and the active ingredients enter your bloodstream. Your blood carries the medicine throughout your body, where it interacts with specific cells, receptors, or tissues to produce its intended effect.
Different medicines work in different ways, but they don’t “search” for pain. Instead, they act wherever their target receptors or biological processes are located.
It’s an amazing process that happens inside your body every time you take the right medicine. 💊
